name: MODEL-006 drawing-to-CAD benchmark
description: Drawing-to-CAD benchmark seeded from benchmarks/drawings/model_006.pdf. The reference model reconstructs the main pipe-elbow body with hollow pipe runs, a swept bend, front circular flange, service port, and rounded top rectangular flange shown in the drawing.

tasks.prompt: Create MODEL NO - 006 from the attached drawing PDF. Reconstruct the main stainless pipe-elbow part as editable CAD: front circular flange OD 57.5mm with 4x Ø5 bolt holes on Ø47.15mm PCD, hollow pipe OD 20mm / ID 15mm, vertical riser, and a 50mm x 40mm top rectangular flange with 4x Ø5 bolt holes and a Ø20 center opening. Use the drawing as the source of truth and keep the model parametric.
assumptions: The benchmark uses a single editable part instead of separate assembly components.
The elbow bend is represented by a swept hollow circular arc so the evaluator can score curved geometry, not just intersecting cylinders.
The small top service port is approximated as a capsule flange with two bolt holes because the drawing view is partially ambiguous.
Dimensions are interpreted in millimeters from MODEL NO - 006, sheet 01.
